mapper.select: SELECT id FROM order_fulfillment_risk WHERE risk_status IN ('pending','processing') AND id>#{after} ORDER BY id LIMIT 100

SELECT r.id,r.source_rental_order_id source_id,r.affected_rental_order_id affected_id,r.sku_id,r.sn_id,r.risk_status status, COALESCE(s.reservation_status,h.reservation_status) source_status,o.order_status affected_status, (SELECT MIN(a.occupy_start_date) FROM inventory_reservation a WHERE a.rental_order_id=o.id AND a.rental_order_item_id=r.affected_order_item_id AND a.sn_id<=>r.sn_id AND a.reservation_status='paid_locked') start_date, (SELECT MAX(a.occupy_end_date) FROM inventory_reservation a WHERE a.rental_order_id=o.id AND a.rental_order_item_id=r.affected_order_item_id AND a.sn_id<=>r.sn_id AND a.reservation_status='paid_locked') end_date FROM order_fulfillment_risk r JOIN rental_order o ON o.id=r.affected_rental_order_id LEFT JOIN inventory_reservation s ON s.id=r.source_reservation_id AND s.rental_order_id=r.source_rental_order_id LEFT JOIN inventory_reservation_history h ON h.origin_reservation_id=r.source_reservation_id AND h.rental_order_id=r.source_rental_order_id WHERE r.id=#{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE order_fulfillment_risk r JOIN admin_case_relation l ON l.relation_type='fulfillment_risk' AND l.relation_id=r.id AND l.is_primary=1 JOIN admin_case c ON c.id=l.admin_case_id AND c.case_type='fulfillment_risk' SET r.risk_status='resolved',r.resolution_remark=#{reason},r.resolved_at=#{at},r.updated_at=#{at}, c.case_status='closed',c.active_case_key=NULL,c.resolution_summary=#{reason},c.closed_at=#{at},c.closed_by_admin_user_id=#{systemId}, c.version=c.version+1,c.updated_at=#{at} WHERE r.id=#{id} AND r.risk_status IN ('pending','processing') AND c.case_status NOT IN ('closed','cancelled')

UPDATE inventory_reservation SET reservation_status='overdue_holding', updated_at=#{at},version=version+1 WHERE rental_order_id=#{orderId} AND reservation_status='renting' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM rental_order o WHERE o.id=#{orderId} AND o.current_due_date<DATE(#{at}))
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM order_fulfillment_event WHERE event_type='rental_overdue' AND processed_at IS NULL AND id>#{after} ORDER BY id LIMIT 100
SELECT id,rental_order_id order_id,event_time FROM order_fulfillment_event WHERE id=#{id} AND event_type='rental_overdue' AND processed_at IS NULL FOR UPDATE

SELECT s.id reservation_id,a.rental_order_id order_id,a.rental_order_item_id item_id,a.sku_id,a.sn_id, s.quantity source_quantity,GREATEST(#{today},a.occupy_start_date,DATE_ADD(s.occupy_end_date,INTERVAL 1 DAY)) start_date, a.occupy_end_date end_date FROM inventory_reservation s JOIN inventory_reservation a ON a.sku_id=s.sku_id AND a.sn_id<=>s.sn_id AND a.rental_order_id<>s.rental_order_id AND a.reservation_status='paid_locked' AND a.occupy_end_date>s.occupy_end_date AND a.occupy_end_date>=#{today} JOIN rental_order o ON o.id=a.rental_order_id AND o.order_status IN ('pending_accept','accepted') WHERE s.rental_order_id=#{source} AND s.reservation_status='overdue_holding' ORDER BY a.rental_order_id,a.rental_order_item_id,s.id
SELECT id FROM rental_order WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT id FROM order_fulfillment_risk WHERE risk_idempotency_key=#{key}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO order_fulfillment_risk(id,source_rental_order_id,risk_idempotency_key,risk_type,source_reservation_id, affected_rental_order_id,affected_order_item_id,sku_id,sn_id,risk_status,created_at,updated_at) VALUES(#{id},#{source},#{key},'overdue_impact',#{row.reservationId},#{row.orderId},#{row.itemId},#{row.skuId}, #{row.snId},'pending',#{at},#{at}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE risk_idempotency_key=order_fulfillment_risk.risk_idempotency_key
mapper.update: UPDATE order_fulfillment_event SET processed_at=#{at} WHERE id=#{id} AND processed_at IS NULL AND event_type='rental_overdue'
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM order_fulfillment_risk WHERE affected_rental_order_id=#{orderId} AND risk_status IN ('pending','processing'))
